placements.why: The document establishes a deployment gate requiring signed release manifests for the Meridian release train — an organizational practice governing how releases are managed and shipped.
placements.title: Release management as a governed practice
placements.theme: Deployment and release processes require explicit governance gates to ensure artifact integrity before shipping.

placements.title: Signed manifests become mandatory for Meridian deploys
placements.theme: Meridian release train deployments now require a signed release manifest before shipping, with scope covering staging and production.
placements.why: src-1 states the CTO directive requiring signed release manifests for every Meridian deployment; src-2 supplies the motivating incident of two unsigned artifacts reaching staging; src-3 restates the gate as a settled rule; src-4 fixes scope to staging and production; src-5 assigns ownership to Quinton Fairweather. Together they support the narrative that signed manifests are now mandatory for Meridian deploys.
